**Synapse Download from UKBB**
```{python}
import synapseclient 
import synapseutils 
import os

#set up credentials
token = $SYNAPSE_AUTH_TOKEN
syn = synapseclient.login(authToken=token)
syn.getUserProfile()

#download all files
files = synapseutils.syncFromSynapse(syn, 'syn52355726', path="~/ukbio/all_race") 
files = synapseutils.syncFromSynapse(syn, 'syn51365303', path="~/ukbio/euro_amer") 
files = synapseutils.syncFromSynapse(syn, 'syn51365304', path="~/ukbio/afr_amer") 
files = synapseutils.syncFromSynapse(syn, 'syn51365306', path="~/ukbio/chn_amer") 
files = synapseutils.syncFromSynapse(syn, 'syn51500434', path="~/ukbio/hisp_amer") 

#gzip tar files
os.system("gzip ~/ukbio/all_race/*")
os.system("gzip ~/ukbio/euro_amer/*")
os.system("gzip ~/ukbio/afr_amer/*")
os.system("gzip ~/ukbio/chn_amer/*")
os.system("gzip ~/ukbio/hisp_amer/*")
```

**Combine tar files**
```{bash}
#!/bin/bash

#set paths
SOURCE_DIR="~/ukbio/ancestry_specific_folder"
OUTPUT_DIR="~/ukbio/ancestry_summary"
LOG_FILE="~/ukbio/ancestry_processing.log"

#set maximum number of parallel jobs
MAX_JOBS=40

#create output directory
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

#initialize log file
echo "Processing started at $(date)" > "$LOG_FILE"

#function to log messages (thread-safe)
log_message() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - $1" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

#function to check if all 23 chromosomes are present in a file
check_chromosomes() {
    local file="$1"
    local temp_check=$(mktemp)
    
    #extract chromosome information from first column (now with "chr" prefix)
    zcat "$file" | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u > "$temp_check"
    
    local expected_chrs=("chr1" "chr2" "chr3" "chr4" "chr5" "chr6" "chr7" "chr8" "chr9" "chr10" "chr11" "chr12" "chr13" "chr14" "chr15" "chr16" "chr17" "chr18" "chr19" "chr20" "chr21" "chr22" "chr23")
    
    #check if we have expected chromosomes
    local missing_chrs=0
    local found_chrs=()
    
    for chr in "${expected_chrs[@]}"; do
        if grep -q "^${chr}$" "$temp_check"; then
            found_chrs+=("$chr")
        else
            log_message "WARNING: Chromosome $chr not found in $file"
            ((missing_chrs++))
        fi
    done
    
    rm "$temp_check"
    
    #consider it successful if we have 23 chromosomes
    local found_count=${#found_chrs[@]}
    if [ $found_count -ge 23 ]; then
        log_message "Found $found_count chromosomes in $file (acceptable)"
        return 0
    else
        log_message "Only found $found_count chromosomes in $file (minimum 23 required)"
        return 1
    fi
}

#function to process chromosome data with ID column modifications
process_chromosome_data() {
    local input_file="$1"
    local output_file="$2"
    
    if file "$input_file" | grep -q "gzip"; then
        zcat "$input_file" | awk '
        BEGIN { OFS="\t" }
        NR==1 {
            #find LOG10P column and modify ID to SNP
            for(i=1; i<=NF; i++) {
                if($i == "LOG10P") log10p_col = i
                if($i == "ID") $i = "SNP"
            }
            #print header with new columns
            for(j=1; j<=NF; j++) {
                printf "%s", $j
                if(j == 3) printf "%sID", OFS
                if(j == log10p_col) printf "%sPvalue", OFS
                if(j < NF) printf "%s", OFS
            }
            printf "\n"
        }
        NR>1 {
            #store original chromosome for ID processing
            orig_chrom = $1
            # Modify chromosome column to add chr prefix
            $1 = "chr" $1
            
            #process ID column based on original chromosome
            new_id = $3
            gsub(/:imp:v1$/, "", new_id)
            
            #check for X chromosome and handle ID accordingly
            if(orig_chrom == "23") {
                #for X chromosome (represented as 23), keep ID as is (no chr prefix)
            } else {
                #for autosomes, add chr prefix to ID
                new_id = "chr" new_id
            }
            
            for(j=1; j<=NF; j++) {
                printf "%s", $j
                if(j == 3) printf "%s%s", OFS, new_id
                if(j == log10p_col) {
                    if($j != "NA" && $j != "") {
                        printf "%s%g", OFS, 10^(-$j)
                    } else {
                        printf "%sNA", OFS
                    }
                }
                if(j < NF) printf "%s", OFS
            }
            printf "\n"
        }' >> "$output_file"
    else
        awk '
        BEGIN { OFS="\t" }
        NR==1 {
            for(i=1; i<=NF; i++) {
                if($i == "LOG10P") log10p_col = i
                if($i == "ID") $i = "SNP"
            }
            for(j=1; j<=NF; j++) {
                printf "%s", $j
                if(j == 3) printf "%sID", OFS
                if(j == log10p_col) printf "%sPvalue", OFS
                if(j < NF) printf "%s", OFS
            }
            printf "\n"
        }
        NR>1 {
            #store original chromosome for ID processing
            orig_chrom = $1
            # Modify chromosome column to add chr prefix
            $1 = "chr" $1
            
            #process ID column based on original chromosome
            new_id = $3
            gsub(/:imp:v1$/, "", new_id)
            
            #check for X chromosome and handle ID accordingly
            if(orig_chrom == "23") {
                # For X chromosome (represented as 23), keep ID as is (no chr prefix)
                # new_id already has :imp:v1 removed, keep it unchanged
            } else {
                # For autosomes, add chr prefix to ID
                new_id = "chr" new_id
            }
            
            for(j=1; j<=NF; j++) {
                printf "%s", $j
                if(j == 3) printf "%s%s", OFS, new_id
                if(j == log10p_col) {
                    if($j != "NA" && $j != "") {
                        printf "%s%g", OFS, 10^(-$j)
                    } else {
                        printf "%sNAu", OFS
                    }
                }
                if(j < NF) printf "%s", OFS
            }
            printf "\n"
        }' "$input_file" >> "$output_file"
    fi
}

#function to process a single tar file
process_tar_file() {
    local tar_file="$1"
    local base_name=$(basename "$tar_file" .tar.gz)
    local temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
    local output_file="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${base_name}_combined.gz"
    local job_id="$BASHPID"  # Use background process ID for job identification
    
    log_message "[Job $job_id] Processing: $tar_file"
    
    #extract tar file to temporary directory
    if ! tar -xzf "$tar_file" -C "$temp_dir"; then
        log_message "[Job $job_id] ERROR: Failed to extract $tar_file"
        rm -rf "$temp_dir"
        return 1
    fi
    
    #find the extracted directory (should contain chromosome files)
    local extracted_dir=$(find "$temp_dir" -type d -name "*" | head -2 | tail -1)
    if [ -z "$extracted_dir" ]; then
        extracted_dir="$temp_dir"
    fi
    
    #count chromosome files
    local chr_files=($(find "$extracted_dir" -name "*chr*" -type f | sort -V))
    if [ ${#chr_files[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        #Try alternative naming pattern
        chr_files=($(find "$extracted_dir" -name "combined_chr*" -type f | sort -V))
    fi
    
    if [ ${#chr_files[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        log_message "[Job $job_id] ERROR: No chromosome files found in $tar_file"
        rm -rf "$temp_dir"
        return 1
    fi
    
    #find LOG10P column position from first file
    local log10p_col=0
    if file "${chr_files[0]}" | grep -q "gzip"; then
        log10p_col=$(zcat "${chr_files[0]}" | head -1 | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="LOG10P") print i}')
    else
        log10p_col=$(head -1 "${chr_files[0]}" | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="LOG10P") print i}')
    fi
    
    #combine all chromosome files with header processing
    local temp_combined=$(mktemp)
    local header_written=false
    
    for chr_file in "${chr_files[@]}"; do
        if [ "$header_written" = false ]; then
            #For the first file, include the header
            process_chromosome_data "$chr_file" "$temp_combined"
            header_written=true
        else
            #for subsequent files, skip the header (process from line 2 onwards)
            if file "$chr_file" | grep -q "gzip"; then
                zcat "$chr_file" | tail -n +2 | awk -v log10p_col="$log10p_col" '
                BEGIN { OFS="\t" }
                {
                    #store original chromosome for ID processing
                    orig_chrom = $1
                    #modify chromosome column to add chr prefix
                    $1 = "chr" $1
                    
                    #process ID column based on original chromosome
                    new_id = $3
                    gsub(/:imp:v1$/, "", new_id)
                    
                    #check for X chromosome and handle ID accordingly
                    if(orig_chrom == "23") {
                        # For X chromosome (represented as 23), keep ID as is (no chr prefix)
                        # new_id already has :imp:v1 removed, keep it unchanged
                    } else {
                        # For autosomes, add chr prefix to ID
                        new_id = "chr" new_id
                    }
                    
                    for(j=1; j<=NF; j++) {
                        printf "%s", $j
                        if(j == 3) printf "%s%s", OFS, new_id
                        if(j == log10p_col) {
                            if($j != "NA" && $j != "") {
                                printf "%s%g", OFS, 10^(-$j)
                            } else {
                                printf "%sNA", OFS
                            }
                        }
                        if(j < NF) printf "%s", OFS
                    }
                    printf "\n"
                }' >> "$temp_combined"
            else
                tail -n +2 "$chr_file" | awk -v log10p_col="$log10p_col" '
                BEGIN { OFS="\t" }
                {
                    #store original chromosome for ID processing
                    orig_chrom = $1
                    # Modify chromosome column to add chr prefix
                    $1 = "chr" $1
                    
                    #process ID column based on original chromosome
                    new_id = $3
                    gsub(/:imp:v1$/, "", new_id)
                    
                    #check for X chromosome and handle ID accordingly
                    if(orig_chrom == "23") {
                        # For X chromosome (represented as 23), keep ID as is (no chr prefix)
                        # new_id already has :imp:v1 removed, keep it unchanged
                    } else {
                        # For autosomes, add chr prefix to ID
                        new_id = "chr" new_id
                    }
                    
                    for(j=1; j<=NF; j++) {
                        printf "%s", $j
                        if(j == 3) printf "%s%s", OFS, new_id
                        if(j == log10p_col) {
                            if($j != "NA" && $j != "") {
                                printf "%s%g", OFS, 10^(-$j)
                            } else {
                                printf "%sNA", OFS
                            }
                        }
                        if(j < NF) printf "%s", OFS
                    }
                    printf "\n"
                }' >> "$temp_combined"
            fi
        fi
    done
    
    #compress the combined file
    gzip -c "$temp_combined" > "$output_file"
    rm "$temp_combined"
    
    #verify the combined file has all chromosomes
    if check_chromosomes "$output_file"; then
        log_message "[Job $job_id] Successfully created and verified: $output_file"
        
        # Clean up: remove original tar file and temporary directory
        rm -f "$tar_file"
        rm -rf "$temp_dir"
        log_message "[Job $job_id] Cleaned up original files for $base_name"
        
        return 0
    else
        log_message "[Job $job_id] Verification failed for $output_file - keeping original files"
        rm -f "$output_file"
        rm -rf "$temp_dir"
        return 1
    fi
}

#function to wait for available job slot - FIXED VERSION
wait_for_slot() {
    while true; do
        # Count actual running processes instead of relying on 'jobs'
        current_jobs=$(pgrep -u claudia -f "combine_tar_files_parallel.sh" | wc -l)
        # Subtract 1 for the main script process
        if [ $current_jobs -gt 0 ]; then
            current_jobs=$((current_jobs - 1))
        fi
        
        if [ $current_jobs -lt $MAX_JOBS ]; then
            break
        fi
        sleep 1
    done
    
    # Always show current job count (including when 0 or when hitting max)
    log_message "Current running jobs: $current_jobs/$MAX_JOBS"
}

#main processing loop
log_message "Starting batch processing of tar files in $SOURCE_DIR with $MAX_JOBS parallel jobs"

#count total files for progress tracking
total_files=$(find "$SOURCE_DIR" -name "*.tar.gz" | wc -l)
log_message "Found $total_files tar.gz files to process"

if [ $total_files -eq 0 ]; then
    log_message "No .tar.gz files found in $SOURCE_DIR"
    exit 1
fi

#process each tar file in parallel
processed=0

#store all tar files in an array first (more reliable than process substitution)
mapfile -t tar_files < <(find "$SOURCE_DIR" -name "*.tar.gz")

for tar_file in "${tar_files[@]}"; do
    #wait for available slot
    wait_for_slot
    
    ((processed++))
    log_message "Progress: $processed/$total_files - Starting $(basename "$tar_file") in background"
    
    #start processing in background
    (
        if process_tar_file "$tar_file"; then
            echo "SUCCESS:$(basename "$tar_file")" >> "${OUTPUT_DIR}/job_results.tmp"
        else
            echo "FAILED:$(basename "$tar_file")" >> "${OUTPUT_DIR}/job_results.tmp"
        fi
    ) &
    
    #show job count after starting each job
    sleep 0.1  # Brief pause to let job start
    current_jobs_after=$(pgrep -u claudia -f "combine_tar_files_parallel.sh" | wc -l)
    if [ $current_jobs_after -gt 0 ]; then
        current_jobs_after=$((current_jobs_after - 1))
    fi
    log_message "Jobs running after starting $(basename "$tar_file"): $current_jobs_after/$MAX_JOBS"
    
    #Progress update every 16 files
    if [ $((processed % 16)) -eq 0 ]; then
        log_message "Progress update: $processed/$total_files files started"
    fi
done

#wait for all background jobs to complete
log_message "Waiting for all background jobs to complete..."
wait

#count results
if [ -f "${OUTPUT_DIR}/job_results.tmp" ]; then
    success_count=$(grep "^SUCCESS:" "${OUTPUT_DIR}/job_results.tmp" | wc -l)
    failed_count=$(grep "^FAILED:" "${OUTPUT_DIR}/job_results.tmp" | wc -l)
    
    log_message "Final Summary:"
    log_message "Successfully processed: $success_count files"
    log_message "Failed to process: $failed_count files"
    
    if [ $failed_count -gt 0 ]; then
        log_message "Failed files:"
        grep "^FAILED:" "${OUTPUT_DIR}/job_results.tmp" | sed 's/^FAILED://' | while read -r failed_file; do
            log_message "  - $failed_file"
        done
    fi
    
    #clean up temp file
    rm -f "${OUTPUT_DIR}/job_results.tmp"
else
    log_message "No results file found - this may indicate an issue with the processing"
fi

log_message "Processing completed at $(date)"
```

**Keep Only Needed Columns in Summary Statistics Files**
```{bash}
#!/bin/bash

INPUT_FOLDER="$1" #"~/ukbio/ancestry_summary"
OUTPUT_FOLDER="$2" #"~/ukbio/ancestry_specific_folder"
MAX_JOBS=20

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_FOLDER"

#function to process a single file
process_file() {
    local file="$1"
    local INPUT_FOLDER="$2"
    local OUTPUT_FOLDER="$3"
    
    [ ! -f "$file" ] && return
    
    filename=$(basename "$file")
    
    #determine if file is compressed and set reader/output
    if [[ "$file" == *.gz ]]; then
        reader="zcat"
        output_name="$filename"  # Keep .gz extension
    else
        reader="cat"
        output_name="${filename}.gz"  # Add .gz extension for uncompressed input
    fi
    
    #check for valid chromosomes and process file, piping through gzip
    $reader "$file" | awk '
        BEGIN { OFS="\t" }
        NR==1 { 
            for(i=1; i<=NF; i++) {
                if($i == "CHROM") chrom_col = i
                if($i != "SNP" && $i != "TEST" && $i != "INFO" && $i != "CHISQ" && $i != "LOG10P" && $i != "EXTRA") {
                    if(!keep_cols) keep_cols = i; else keep_cols = keep_cols "," i
                }
            }
            if(!chrom_col) { print "FAIL: no CHROM column" > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1 }
            
            split(keep_cols, cols, ",")
            for(j=1; j<=length(cols); j++) {
                printf "%s%s", $cols[j], (j<length(cols) ? "\t" : "\n")
            }
        }
        NR>1 && chrom_col && $chrom_col ~ /^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-3])$/ {
            has_valid = 1
            split(keep_cols, cols, ",")
            for(j=1; j<=length(cols); j++) {
                printf "%s%s", $cols[j], (j<length(cols) ? "\t" : "\n")
            }
        }
        END { if(!has_valid) { print "FAIL: no valid chromosomes" > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1 } }
    ' | gzip > "$OUTPUT_FOLDER/$output_name" 2>"$OUTPUT_FOLDER/.error_$$"
    
    if [ $? -ne 0 ] || [ ! -s "$OUTPUT_FOLDER/$output_name" ]; then
        echo "$filename: $(cat "$OUTPUT_FOLDER/.error_$$" 2>/dev/null || echo "FAIL")"
        rm -f "$OUTPUT_FOLDER/$output_name"
    else
        echo "$filename: SUCCESS - removing original file"
        rm -f "$file"
    fi
    rm -f "$OUTPUT_FOLDER/.error_$$"
}

#process files in parallel
for file in "$INPUT_FOLDER"/*; do
    [ ! -f "$file" ] && continue
    
    #wait if we have too many background jobs
    while [ $(jobs -r | wc -l) -ge $MAX_JOBS ]; do
        sleep 0.1
    done
    
    #start processing file in background
    process_file "$file" "$INPUT_FOLDER" "$OUTPUT_FOLDER" &
done

#wait for all remaining jobs to complete
wait

echo "All files processed"
```
